description: Fix 4 interconnected bugs: 1) 430km distance (pixels treated as meters without calibration), 2) FieldView shows nothing (route points in pixel space), 3) Single player mode fails (timestamp-based IDs vs integer track IDs), 4) Manual calibration needs simpler PlayArea approach.
steps: Add LinearFieldTransform class to backend/src/cv/transform.py for simple rectangle-based field mapping
Modify backend/src/cv/video_processor.py: Add default pixel-to-field normalization (60m x 40m) when no transform is provided, store frame dimensions, add target acquisition phase for single player
Modify backend/src/api/routes/video.py: Handle play_area calibration data to create LinearFieldTransform, pass player selection bounding boxes for target acquisition
Add PlayArea calibration mode to frontend/src/components/FieldCalibration.tsx with draggable rectangle on field SVG
Update frontend/src/pages/AnalysisPage.tsx to pass play_area and player selection bbox to processing config
acceptance_criteria: Without calibration, distances are computed in field-meter space (60m x 40m frame assumption) not pixels
FieldView displays route points correctly within 0-100 x 0-70 field space
Single player mode identifies the correct YOLO track by matching the user's drawn bounding box via IoU
PlayArea calibration mode allows user to draw a rectangle on the 2D field diagram indicating what area the video covers
PlayArea calibration produces a LinearFieldTransform that correctly maps pixel coordinates to the specified field region
findings: All 215 backend tests pass. All 30 frontend tests pass. Frontend builds successfully (chunk size warning is pre-existing). The DefaultFieldTransform assumes 60m x 40m visible area centered on the field (offset 20m, 15m). The LinearFieldTransform maps pixel coords to a user-specified rectangle on the field. Target acquisition uses IoU >= 0.2 threshold over first 10 frames. The PlayArea calibration tab (Zona de Juego) is now the default tab in FieldCalibration component.
